# MDN201 `old-mpi-module`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

`use mpi` instead of `use mpi_f08`.

## Why

The `mpi` module gives only partial argument checking (handles are plain integers, buffers are
untyped); `mpi_f08` provides typed handles (`type(MPI_Comm)` ...) and optional `ierror`, so the
compiler catches mismatched arguments.

## Reported

```fortran
use mpi
```

## Preferred

```fortran
use mpi_f08
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[MDN201] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = MDN201` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `MOD201` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
